clips.title: The story
paras: Gan'rul Bloodeye sends an aspiring Horde warlock to begin the path to summoning and commanding a succubus. In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, the warlock seeks Cazul's counsel on luring and binding the demon.

Horde warlocks who master lesser demons such as imps and voidwalkers may seek a succubus next. Gan'rul Bloodeye oversees the dark arts beneath Orgrimmar and judges when a warlock is ready to call one from the Twisting Nether. A succubus can turn the frail against themselves, so binding one takes subtlety as well as strength.

A succubus preys on mortal desire, so raw incantations cannot call one alone. The summoner must lure it with an object filled with pure love and devotion. Gan'rul is unwilling or unable to provide such a relic himself, so he sends the warlock across the Cleft of Shadow to Cazul. The ancient warlock knows the arcane and demonic rites needed for the next part of the ritual.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The time has come for you to learn more of the summoning magics. You will learn to summon a succubus, a creature of incredible mental powers. It can lull those of weak minds into its servitude—but have no fear! I feel certain that you will be equal to the challenge.
A succubus can only be summoned when baited with an item that represents great devotion and love. I leave it to you to find such an object.
A suggestion? Speak with Cazul... There seems to be little the ancient warlock does not know.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm... Friend. You are still new to your path, but I sense the possibility for greatness in you.
You were born with gifts, friend. See that they do not go to waste.
